# Complete Leaf-Segment Configuration Comparison

This is the numeric appendix to the [corrected analysis report](similarity-analysis-report.md). Each section is one independent `(service, service_sub, channel)` series. Every section lists all 700 main-grid settings, ordered by tuning seven-day top-three RMSE. Holdout columns were not used to select the segment winner. No subscriber counts are summed across sections.
